The test image shows a soybean leaf with scattered small-to-medium dark brown lesions with yellowish halos, some with tissue dropout creating holes. Top candidates: **Bacterial_Blight**, **Septoria_brown_spot**, **Frogeye_leaf_spot**, **Downy_mildew**.

Let me view reference images for these candidates.
The Frogeye leaf spot reference (top-right panel) closely matches the test image's pattern - scattered dark spots on green leaf with tissue dropout. Let me compare more candidates.
Now let me look at a few more candidates to confirm.

Now I have sufficient evidence to make my assessment.

**Key observations from the test image:**
- Green soybean leaf (upper surface)
- Scattered small-to-medium dark brown/chocolate brown spots
- Prominent **yellowish-green halos** surrounding lesions
- **Tissue dropout** creating visible holes (ragged appearance)
- Irregular to somewhat angular spot shapes
- Spots vary in size, not merging yet

**Comparison with candidates:**
- **Bacterial_Blight**: Best match — yellowish-green halos around darkened lesions, tissue falling out creating ragged/holey appearance, angular-ish spots on green leaf. Reference top-left panel aligns well.
- **Frogeye_leaf_spot**: Shows gray-centered lesions with reddish-brown borders — the test image spots are dark brown throughout, not gray-centered.
- **Septoria_brown_spot**: Associated with heavy yellowing/defoliation of the whole leaf; lesions much smaller and more numerous.
- **Bacterial_Pustule**: Shows light-colored pustules/blisters, not dark brown spots with yellow halos.
- **Cercospora**: Purple/bronze blotchy discoloration, not discrete spotted lesions with halos.
- **Downy_mildew**: Pale yellow spots and fungal tufts underneath, not dark brown spots.

The **yellowish-green halos** and **tissue dropout creating holes** are the most diagnostic features, pointing clearly to **Bacterial_Blight**.

Frogeye was ruled out due to absence of gray-centered lesions; septoria ruled out due to absence of heavy leaf yellowing and the prominent halos; cercospora and downy mildew don't match the discrete spotted pattern with halos."}
